selection.reason: Current schema7 candidate-completion-first policy was introduced at precommit HEAD 2ada3acd. Before selecting B00119, this task audited B-even current shared/C-accepted evidence. No RENDER_READY or ONE_STAGE_TO_RENDER B asset can safely advance with current GitHub evidence: the only shared-state CLEAN_PLATE-ready index is 215 (odd/A); B pre-generation evidence retains CLEAN_PLATE/source-identity HOLD; existing B candidates are C/runtime-only or dependency-blocked rather than missing-render candidates.
